1	defmodule Aiur.Claude.ReplAgent do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Persistent interactive-REPL Claude backend implementing the CodingAgent
4	  behaviour.
5	
6	  Where `Aiur.Claude.CodingAgent` spawns `claude --print` one-shot per turn
7	  over JSON-RPC stdio, this driver keeps ONE long-lived interactive `claude`
8	  process alive in a hidden tmux pane and drives it with `send-keys`. Because
9	  the process persists, it can be launched with `--remote-control` so the same
10	  agent is also drivable from the Claude app (phone / claude.ai/code) — both
11	  surfaces share one transcript. Turn output is read by tailing that transcript
12	  jsonl (see `Aiur.Claude.TranscriptTailer`), not by scraping the pane.
13	
14	  This module owns the session lifecycle: spawn the pane, wait for the REPL to
15	  become ready, optionally attach Remote Control, resolve the transcript path
16	  (cwd + newest mtime — the interactive `/remote-control` path writes no
17	  `bridge-pointer.json`), and tear the pane + process down cleanly so no
18	  `claude` process is orphaned.
19	  """
20	
21	  @behaviour Aiur.CodingAgent
22	
23	  require Logger
24	
25	  alias Aiur.Claude.Config
26	  alias Aiur.Claude.HookEvents
27	  alias Aiur.Claude.HookSettings
28	  alias Aiur.Claude.RemoteControl
29	  alias Aiur.Claude.TranscriptTailer
30	  alias Aiur.Tmux
31	
32	  @ready_prompt "❯"
33	  @ready_poll_ms 200
34	  @ready_timeout_ms 15_000
35	
36	  # REPL panes live in their own tmux window named `aiur-repl-<beam_os_pid>-<n>`.
37	  # Embedding the owning BEAM's os pid lets the boot reaper kill only panes
38	  # whose owner is dead (never a side-by-side aiur instance's live panes) and
39	  # lets the shutdown sweep kill only this instance's own panes.
40	  @repl_window_prefix "aiur-repl-"
41	
42	  # How often `run_turn` drains the transcript tailer and checks pane
43	  # liveness while a turn is in flight.
44	  @turn_poll_ms 250
45	
46	  # After a pause request interrupts the live turn (Ctrl+C to the pane), how
47	  # long to wait for the tailer to observe the turn closing before parking
48	  # the agent as paused anyway. Expiry parks rather than errors: returning
49	  # `{:error, :turn_timeout}` would book a failed turn and possibly
50	  # re-dispatch, and looping forever would hang the pause.
51	  @pause_confirm_ms 10_000
52	
53	  # Cold start: claude writes no session jsonl until the first user message
54	  # is submitted, so the first turn sends the prompt, then waits for the file
55	  # to materialize before tailing it.
56	  @transcript_wait_ms 15_000
57	  @transcript_poll_ms 100
58	
59	  # The REPL renders its prompt glyph (`@ready_prompt`) before it actually
60	  # accepts input — and a `--remote-control` session lags further while it
61	  # connects — so the first paste is routinely dropped. Delivery is only safe
62	  # once the prompt lands in the input buffer, so we keep re-pasting (clearing
63	  # the line first) on `@echo_retype_ms` until the buffer confirms it or
64	  # `@echo_confirm_ms` elapses; only then does Enter submit. Without this,
65	  # Enter submits a blank line and the turn silently does nothing, the
66	  # transcript never appears, and the run fails `:no_transcript`.
67	  @echo_confirm_ms 20_000
68	  @echo_retype_ms 1_500
69	  @echo_poll_ms 100
70	
71	  # A multi-line prompt is delivered as a bracketed paste, which the REPL
72	  # renders as a collapsed `[Pasted text +N lines]` chip rather than echoing
73	  # the literal text — so the buffer-landed check matches this chip as well as
74	  # a verbatim prefix (short single-line prompts still echo literally).
75	  @paste_indicator "[Pasted text"
76	
77	  # When launched with `--remote-control`, the REPL prints a
78	  # `… https://claude.ai/code/session_… ` banner to the pane as it attaches,
79	  # alongside the ready prompt. Scan the pane for it once the REPL is ready;
80	  # it is a capability token surfaced only to the operator display, never
81	  # logged. The banner is also the proof RC attached: an account without RC
82	  # entitlement never prints it, so its absence within this budget is taken
83	  # as RC-unavailable and degrades the session to the non-RC backend (see
84	  # `build_ready_session/3`). The window is generous so a slow-but-working
85	  # attach is never mistaken for an unavailable one.
86	  @url_capture_timeout_ms 10_000
87	  @url_poll_ms 150
88	
89	  @type session :: %{
90	          backend: String.t(),
91	          pane_id: String.t(),
92	          os_pid: integer() | nil,
93	          workspace: Path.t(),
94	          transcript_path: Path.t() | nil,
95	          projects_dir: Path.t() | nil,
96	          started_at: integer(),
97	          model: String.t() | nil,
98	          remote_control: boolean(),
99	          rc_name: String.t() | nil,
100	          session_url: String.t() | nil,
101	          identifier: String.t() | nil,
102	          tmux: GenServer.server()
103	        }
104	
105	  @spec start_session(Path.t(), keyword()) :: {:ok, session()} | {:error, term()}
106	  def start_session(workspace, opts \\ []) when is_binary(workspace) do
107	    tmux = Keyword.get(opts, :tmux, Tmux)
108	    expanded = Path.expand(workspace)
109	    model = Keyword.get(opts, :model) || Config.model()
110	    rc? = Keyword.get(opts, :remote_control, false)
111	    repl_name = default_repl_name()
112	    rc_name = Keyword.get(opts, :rc_name) || repl_name
113	    window_name = Keyword.get(opts, :window_name) || repl_name
114	
115	    # Captured before spawn so per-turn resolution can ignore any stale
116	    # transcript left by a prior run on this same workspace — claude writes
117	    # the live session's jsonl only at first-message time, always after this.
118	    started_at = System.os_time(:second)
119	
120	    # RC sessions emit no structured stdout, so turn detection rides on claude
121	    # lifecycle hooks POSTed to the dashboard. Inject them via --settings (which
122	    # composes with the operator's own settings). Best-effort: a missing
123	    # identifier or unbound dashboard degrades to no hooks rather than failing.
124	    settings_path = maybe_hook_settings(rc?, Keyword.get(opts, :identifier))
125	    command = build_command(expanded, model, rc?, rc_name, settings_path)
126	
127	    Aiur.Perf.event(:repl_agent_spawn, workspace: expanded, remote_control: rc?)
128	
129	    ctx = %{
130	      tmux: tmux,
131	      workspace: expanded,
132	      model: model,
133	      rc?: rc?,
134	      rc_name: rc_name,
135	      identifier: Keyword.get(opts, :identifier),
136	      hooks?: is_binary(settings_path),
137	      started_at: started_at,
138	      opts: opts
139	    }
140	
141	    case Tmux.new_hidden_window(tmux, window_name, command) do
142	      {:ok, pane_id} ->
143	        finish_start(ctx, pane_id)
144	
145	      {:error, _reason} = err ->
146	        err
147	    end
148	  end
149	
150	  defp finish_start(%{tmux: tmux, opts: opts} = ctx, pane_id) do
151	    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :ready_timeout_ms, @ready_timeout_ms)
152	
153	    case await_ready(tmux, pane_id, timeout) do
154	      :ok ->
155	        os_pid =
156	          case Tmux.pane_pid(tmux, pane_id) do
157	            {:ok, pid} -> pid
158	            _ -> nil
159	          end
160	
161	        Aiur.Perf.event(:repl_agent_ready,
162	          workspace: ctx.workspace,
163	          pane_id: pane_id,
164	          os_pid: os_pid,
165	          remote_control: ctx.rc?
166	        )
167	
168	        # The pane runs `exec claude`, so the pane pid IS the REPL; register
169	        # both so shutdown reaps survive either teardown path going stale.
170	        Aiur.ProcessReaper.register(:agent, {:pane, pane_id})
171	        Aiur.ProcessReaper.register(:agent, {:os_pid, os_pid}, comm: "claude")
172	
173	        build_ready_session(ctx, pane_id, os_pid)
174	
175	      {:error, :repl_not_ready} = err ->
176	        # Readiness failed but the pane exists — kill it so nothing leaks.
177	        Tmux.kill_pane(tmux, pane_id)
178	        err
179	    end
180	  end
181	
182	  # A `--remote-control` REPL only earns RC mode if it actually attaches: the
183	  # REPL prints a `https://claude.ai/code/session_…` banner once the cloud
184	  # session goes live. On an account without RC entitlement the banner never
185	  # appears (and every later `send-keys` would time out as
186	  # `:prompt_not_delivered`), so a missing banner means RC-unavailable. Tear
187	  # the pane down and return `:remote_control_unavailable` so the runner
188	  # degrades to the non-RC headless backend rather than stranding the issue.
189	  # A non-RC REPL skips this gate entirely.
190	  defp build_ready_session(%{rc?: true} = ctx, pane_id, os_pid) do
191	    case capture_session_url(ctx.tmux, pane_id, ctx.opts) do
192	      url when is_binary(url) ->
193	        {:ok, repl_session(ctx, pane_id, os_pid, url)}
194	
195	      nil ->
196	        Tmux.kill_pane(ctx.tmux, pane_id)
197	        RemoteControl.graceful_kill_tree(os_pid)
198	
199	        Aiur.Perf.event(:repl_agent_rc_unavailable, workspace: ctx.workspace, pane_id: pane_id)
200	        Logger.warning("claude-repl remote-control did not attach; degrading to non-RC backend")
201	
202	        {:error, :remote_control_unavailable}
203	    end
204	  end
205	
206	  defp build_ready_session(%{rc?: false} = ctx, pane_id, os_pid) do
207	    {:ok, repl_session(ctx, pane_id, os_pid, nil)}
208	  end
209	
210	  defp repl_session(ctx, pane_id, os_pid, session_url) do
211	    %{
212	      backend: "claude-repl",
213	      pane_id: pane_id,
214	      os_pid: os_pid,
215	      workspace: ctx.workspace,
216	      transcript_path: nil,
217	      started_at: ctx.started_at,
218	      projects_dir: Keyword.get(ctx.opts, :projects_dir),
219	      model: ctx.model,
220	      remote_control: ctx.rc?,
221	      rc_name: ctx.rc_name,
222	      session_url: session_url,
223	      # Set only when lifecycle hooks were injected (see maybe_hook_settings/2);
224	      # its presence is what routes run_turn to hook-driven detection.
225	      identifier: if(Map.get(ctx, :hooks?, false), do: ctx.identifier, else: nil),
226	      tmux: ctx.tmux
227	    }
228	  end
229	
230	  # Scan the just-ready pane for the Remote Control session URL. Polls until
231	  # the banner lands or the budget elapses — it can appear a beat after the
232	  # prompt. Returns nil when it never appears; for an RC session that nil is
233	  # the RC-unavailable signal (see `build_ready_session/3`).
234	  # RC-attach evidence takes one of two on-pane forms:
235	  #   * banner form: a `/remote-control is active · … https://claude.ai/code/
236	  #     session_…` banner prints into the pane — the URL is right there.
237	  #   * footer form: only a small `/rc active` indicator shows. Harvest the
238	  #     URL by running the `/rc` slash command, whose dialog prints "This
239	  #     session is available … at https://claude.ai/code/session_…", then
240	  #     dismiss it with Esc.
241	  # Poll for either signal; missing both within the budget means RC never
242	  # attached (entitlement absent / link down) and the caller degrades.
243	  defp capture_session_url(tmux, pane_id, opts) do
244	    timeout = Keyword.get(opts, :url_capture_timeout_ms, @url_capture_timeout_ms)
245	    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + timeout
246	
247	    case poll_rc_evidence(tmux, pane_id, deadline) do
248	      {:url, url} -> url
249	      :rc_active -> harvest_url_via_rc_command(tmux, pane_id)
250	      :none -> nil
251	    end
252	  end
253	
254	  defp poll_rc_evidence(tmux, pane_id, deadline) do
255	    text =
256	      case Tmux.capture_pane(tmux, pane_id) do
257	        {:ok, lines} -> Enum.join(lines, "\n")
258	        _ -> ""
259	      end
260	
261	    cond do
262	      url = RemoteControl.parse_session_url(text) ->
263	        {:url, url}
264	
265	      String.contains?(text, "/rc active") ->
266	        :rc_active
267	
268	      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) >= deadline ->
269	        :none
270	
271	      true ->
272	        Process.sleep(@url_poll_ms)
273	        poll_rc_evidence(tmux, pane_id, deadline)
274	    end
275	  end
276	
277	  # Type `/rc`, submit, scrape the dialog for the session URL, and ALWAYS
278	  # dismiss with Esc so the dialog can't eat the first prompt's keystrokes.
279	  # A short dedicated budget: the dialog renders locally (no network wait).
280	  @rc_dialog_timeout_ms 5_000
281	  defp harvest_url_via_rc_command(tmux, pane_id) do
282	    url =
283	      with :ok <- Tmux.send_keys_literal(tmux, pane_id, "/rc"),
284	           :ok <- Tmux.send_enter(tmux, pane_id) do
285	        dialog_deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + @rc_dialog_timeout_ms
286	        do_capture_session_url(tmux, pane_id, dialog_deadline)
287	      else
288	        _ -> nil
289	      end
290	
291	    _ = Tmux.send_escape(tmux, pane_id)
292	    url
293	  end
294	
295	  defp do_capture_session_url(tmux, pane_id, deadline) do
296	    url =
297	      case Tmux.capture_pane(tmux, pane_id) do

435	  @doc """
436	  Drive one turn over the persistent REPL.
437	
438	  Sends `prompt` to the live pane (`paste_text` + `Enter`), tails the
439	  shared transcript for this turn's output (forwarding each extracted
440	  `transcript_event` to `on_message`), and blocks until the agent's terminal
441	  `stop_reason` lands or a backstop fires:
442	
443	    * `{:ok, %{result, session_id, thread_id, turn_id}}` on completion
444	    * `{:error, :empty_prompt}` if the prompt is blank (no keys sent)
445	    * `{:error, :no_transcript}` if a cold-start turn's jsonl never appeared
446	    * `{:error, :turn_timeout}` if no completion arrives within the backstop;
447	      the session stays usable for the next turn
448	    * `{:error, :repl_gone}` if the pane dies mid-turn
449	
450	  On a warm turn the tailer opens `from: :end` so it captures only this
451	  turn's newly-appended records. On a cold-start turn (no jsonl yet) the
452	  prompt is sent first so claude creates the file, then the tailer opens
453	  `from: :start` to pick up records written before it attached. Either way
454	  the tailer never replays prior history as input to the agent.
455	  """
456	  @spec run_turn(session(), String.t(), map(), keyword()) ::
457	          {:ok, map()} | {:paused, map()} | {:error, term()}
458	  def run_turn(session, prompt, issue, opts \\ [])
459	
460	  def run_turn(_session, prompt, _issue, _opts) when not is_binary(prompt),
461	    do: {:error, :empty_prompt}
462	
463	  def run_turn(%{} = session, prompt, _issue, opts) do
464	    if String.trim(prompt) == "" do
465	      {:error, :empty_prompt}
466	    else
467	      drive_turn(session, prompt, opts)
468	    end
469	  end

471	  defp drive_turn(session, prompt, opts) do
472	    if is_binary(Map.get(session, :identifier)) do
473	      drive_turn_via_hooks(session, prompt, opts)
474	    else
475	      drive_turn_via_transcript(session, prompt, opts)
476	    end
477	  end

479	  # Hook-driven turn: claude v2.1.177 flushes its transcript lazily, so we drive
480	  # turn detection off lifecycle hooks (Aiur.Claude.HookEvents) instead. Send the
481	  # prompt, then wait on the agent's hook topic: PostToolUse streams progress and
482	  # heartbeats the backstop, Stop completes the turn with `last_assistant_message`.
483	  # There is no completion clock — only the Stop event, pane death, or a generous
484	  # no-event backstop ends the wait — so a turn that works silently for minutes is
485	  # never failed.
486	  defp drive_turn_via_hooks(session, prompt, opts) do
487	    on_message = Keyword.get(opts, :on_message, fn _ -> :ok end)
488	    on_operator = Keyword.get(opts, :on_operator_message, fn -> :noop end)
489	    poll_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :poll_interval_ms, @turn_poll_ms)
490	    timeout_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :turn_timeout_ms) || Aiur.Config.agent_turn_timeout_ms()
491	    pause_confirm_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :pause_confirm_ms, @pause_confirm_ms)
492	    identifier = session.identifier
493	
494	    :ok = HookEvents.subscribe(identifier)
495	
496	    try do
497	      case submit_prompt(session, prompt, opts) do
498	        :ok ->
499	          # Backstop deadline is reset by every hook event, so it only fires for a
500	          # session that has gone fully silent (no tools, no Stop) — not a long turn.
501	          deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + timeout_ms
502	
503	          loop = %{
504	            session: session,
505	            identifier: identifier,
506	            on_message: on_message,
507	            on_operator: on_operator,
508	            poll_ms: poll_ms,
509	            pause_confirm_ms: pause_confirm_ms,
510	            timeout_ms: timeout_ms
511	          }
512	
513	          loop
514	          |> await_hook_turn(deadline, %{session_id: nil, message: nil})
515	          |> finish_hook_turn(on_message)
516	
517	        {:error, reason} ->
518	          emit(on_message, :turn_ended_with_error, %{reason: reason})
519	          {:error, reason}
520	      end
521	    after
522	      HookEvents.unsubscribe(identifier)
523	    end
524	  end

526	  # Receive loop driven by claude lifecycle hooks. Returns `:ok` (with the captured
527	  # response/session in `acc`), `{:paused, _}`, or `{:error, reason}`.
528	  defp await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc) do
529	    cond do
530	      not pane_alive?(loop.session) ->
531	        {:error, :repl_gone}
532	
533	      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) >= deadline ->
534	        # No hook event at all within the (event-reset) backstop window: treat as a
535	        # stalled session. Not the normal completion path — that is the Stop event.
536	        Logger.warning("repl_hook_turn backstop_timeout identifier=#{loop.identifier}")
537	        {:error, :turn_timeout}
538	
539	      true ->
540	        receive do
541	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :stop} = event} ->
542	            {:ok, %{acc | session_id: event.session_id || acc.session_id, message: event.message}}
543	
544	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :post_tool_use} = event} ->
545	            # PostToolUse is a liveness heartbeat for turn detection only — the
546	            # conversation (incl. tool I/O) is painted by Aiur.Claude.DisplayTailer
547	            # from the transcript jsonl, so nothing is rendered from here.
548	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), merge_session(acc, event))
549	
550	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :user_prompt_submit} = event} ->
551	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), merge_session(acc, event))
552	
553	          {:claude_hook, _id, _event} ->
554	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), acc)
555	
556	          # An operator message landed mid-turn. The REPL accepts input while the
557	          # agent works; type it straight in so claude's native queue folds it.
558	          {:agent_queue_updated, _identifier, _item_id, true} ->
559	            Logger.info("repl_hook_turn operator_immediate identifier=#{loop.identifier}")
560	            deliver_immediate_operator_message(loop.session, loop.on_operator)
561	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
562	
563	          {:agent_queue_updated, _identifier, _item_id, _deliver_now} ->
564	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
565	
566	          {:agent_queue_updated, _identifier, _item_id} ->
567	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
568	
569	          # Pause request: interrupt the live REPL turn (Ctrl+C to the pane) and
570	          # park as paused. The interrupted turn still fires a Stop hook, which the
571	          # next turn's loop drains harmlessly.
572	          {:pause_agent, request_id} when is_integer(request_id) ->
573	            case interrupt(loop.session) do
574	              :ok -> :ok
575	              {:error, reason} -> Logger.warning("repl_pause interrupt_failed reason=#{inspect(reason)}")
576	            end
577	
578	            {:paused, %{request_id: request_id}}
579	        after
580	          loop.poll_ms ->
581	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
582	        end
583	    end
584	  end

611	  defp drive_turn_via_transcript(session, prompt, opts) do
612	    on_message = Keyword.get(opts, :on_message, fn _ -> :ok end)
613	    on_operator = Keyword.get(opts, :on_operator_message, fn -> :noop end)
614	    poll_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :poll_interval_ms, @turn_poll_ms)
615	    timeout_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :turn_timeout_ms) || Aiur.Config.agent_turn_timeout_ms()
616	    pause_confirm_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :pause_confirm_ms, @pause_confirm_ms)
617	
618	    case prepare_turn(session, prompt, opts) do
619	      {:ok, transcript_path, from, prompt_sent?} ->
620	        session = %{session | transcript_path: transcript_path}
621	        {thread_id, turn_id} = turn_ids(transcript_path)
622	        session_id = "#{thread_id}-#{turn_id}"
623	
624	        emit(on_message, :session_started, %{
625	          session_id: session_id,
626	          thread_id: thread_id,
627	          turn_id: turn_id
628	        })
629	
630	        {:ok, tailer} = start_turn_tailer(session, turn_id, from, on_message)
631	
632	        # Warm turns send AFTER the tailer attaches so no record is missed;
633	        # cold turns already sent the prompt to create the transcript.
634	        send_result = if prompt_sent?, do: :ok, else: send_prompt(session, prompt, opts)
635	
636	        case send_result do
637	          :ok ->
638	            deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + timeout_ms
639	            result = await_turn(session, tailer, turn_id, deadline, poll_ms, on_operator, pause_confirm_ms)

641	            finish_turn(result, on_message, session_id, thread_id, turn_id)

643	          {:error, reason} ->

647	        end

649	      {:error, reason} ->
650	        {:error, reason}
651	    end
652	  end

654	  defp finish_turn(:ok, on_message, session_id, thread_id, turn_id) do

711	  # Hook-driven (RC) submit: paste the prompt, wait for it to land in the input
712	  # box, then Enter. The wait is load-bearing — a large multi-line paste-buffer

714	  # Enter immediately races the paste and leaves the prompt sitting unsubmitted
715	  # (claude never starts a turn, no hooks fire). Unlike confirm_typed this never
716	  # clears/retypes (that C-u reads as an interrupt that cancels a live turn) and
717	  # never fails the run: if the paste does not echo within the budget (claude
718	  # folded it into its native queue mid-turn, clearing the input box), Enter
719	  # still fires best-effort and the UserPromptSubmit hook confirms receipt.
720	  defp submit_prompt(session, prompt, opts) do
721	    with :ok <- Tmux.paste_text(session.tmux, session.pane_id, prompt) do
722	      _ = await_paste_landed(session, prompt, opts)
723	      Tmux.send_enter(session.tmux, session.pane_id)

725	  end

727	  # Poll the input buffer (read-only — no clear, no retype) until the paste
728	  # lands as the `[Pasted text` chip or the prompt prefix, so Enter submits it
729	  # instead of racing the paste-buffer. Best-effort: returns `:timeout` once the
730	  # budget elapses rather than erroring, so a mid-turn fold (no chip) still
731	  # falls through to a harmless Enter + hook-confirmed receipt.
732	  defp await_paste_landed(session, prompt, opts) do
733	    confirm_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :prompt_confirm_ms, @echo_confirm_ms)

735	    deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + confirm_ms
736	    poll_paste_landed(session, prefix, deadline)

739	  defp poll_paste_landed(session, prefix, deadline) do
740	    cond do
741	      input_echoes?(session, prefix) ->
742	        :ok
743	
744	      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) >= deadline ->
745	        :timeout
746	
747	      true ->
748	        Process.sleep(@echo_poll_ms)
749	        poll_paste_landed(session, prefix, deadline)
750	    end
751	  end

753	  # Only submit (Enter) once the typed prompt has actually echoed into the
754	  # input buffer; a dropped send must never be committed as a blank line.
755	  defp send_prompt(session, prompt, opts) do
756	    case confirm_typed(session, prompt, opts) do
757	      :ok -> Tmux.send_enter(session.tmux, session.pane_id)
758	      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
759	    end

762	  # Paste the prompt, then poll the input buffer until it lands. The REPL
763	  # renders its glyph before it accepts input (and an RC session lags
764	  # further), so the first paste is routinely dropped — keep clearing the line
765	  # and re-pasting on `retype_ms` until the buffer reflects it. Fail loudly
766	  # with `:prompt_not_delivered` if the budget elapses with nothing landed,
767	  # rather than submitting a blank line. Reads the pane only to confirm input
768	  # (not output).
769	  defp confirm_typed(session, prompt, opts) do
770	    confirm_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :prompt_confirm_ms, @echo_confirm_ms)
771	    retype_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :prompt_retype_ms, @echo_retype_ms)
772	    prefix = echo_prefix(prompt)
773	    Tmux.paste_text(session.tmux, session.pane_id, prompt)
774	    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
775	    poll_echo(session, prompt, prefix, confirm_ms, retype_ms, now, now)
776	  end

778	  defp poll_echo(session, prompt, prefix, confirm_ms, retype_ms, start, last_retype) do
779	    elapsed = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start
780	
781	    cond do
782	      input_echoes?(session, prefix) ->
783	        :ok
784	
785	      elapsed >= confirm_ms ->
786	        {:error, :prompt_not_delivered}
787	
788	      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - last_retype >= retype_ms ->
789	        # The paste was dropped (glyph showed before the REPL was live);
790	        # clear any partial buffer and re-paste now that it may be ready.
791	        Tmux.clear_input(session.tmux, session.pane_id)
792	        Tmux.paste_text(session.tmux, session.pane_id, prompt)
793	        Process.sleep(@echo_poll_ms)
794	        now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
795	        poll_echo(session, prompt, prefix, confirm_ms, retype_ms, start, now)
796	
797	      true ->
798	        Process.sleep(@echo_poll_ms)
799	        poll_echo(session, prompt, prefix, confirm_ms, retype_ms, start, last_retype)
800	    end
801	  end

803	  defp input_echoes?(session, prefix) do
804	    case Tmux.capture_pane(session.tmux, session.pane_id) do
805	      {:ok, lines} ->

807	        String.contains?(joined, prefix) or String.contains?(joined, @paste_indicator)

809	      _ ->

436	  Drive one turn over the persistent REPL.
437	
438	  Sends `prompt` to the live pane (`paste_text` + `Enter`), tails the
439	  shared transcript for this turn's output (forwarding each extracted
440	  `transcript_event` to `on_message`), and blocks until the agent's terminal
441	  `stop_reason` lands or a backstop fires:
442	
443	    * `{:ok, %{result, session_id, thread_id, turn_id}}` on completion
444	    * `{:error, :empty_prompt}` if the prompt is blank (no keys sent)
445	    * `{:error, :no_transcript}` if a cold-start turn's jsonl never appeared
446	    * `{:error, :turn_timeout}` if no completion arrives within the backstop;
447	      the session stays usable for the next turn
448	    * `{:error, :repl_gone}` if the pane dies mid-turn
449	
450	  On a warm turn the tailer opens `from: :end` so it captures only this
451	  turn's newly-appended records. On a cold-start turn (no jsonl yet) the
452	  prompt is sent first so claude creates the file, then the tailer opens
453	  `from: :start` to pick up records written before it attached. Either way
454	  the tailer never replays prior history as input to the agent.
455	  """
456	  @spec run_turn(session(), String.t(), map(), keyword()) ::
457	          {:ok, map()} | {:paused, map()} | {:error, term()}

460	  def run_turn(_session, prompt, _issue, _opts) when not is_binary(prompt),
461	    do: {:error, :empty_prompt}

463	  def run_turn(%{} = session, prompt, _issue, opts) do
464	    if String.trim(prompt) == "" do
465	      {:error, :empty_prompt}

472	    if is_binary(Map.get(session, :identifier)) do

479	  # Hook-driven turn: claude v2.1.177 flushes its transcript lazily, so we drive
480	  # turn detection off lifecycle hooks (Aiur.Claude.HookEvents) instead. Send the
481	  # prompt, then wait on the agent's hook topic: PostToolUse streams progress and
482	  # heartbeats the backstop, Stop completes the turn with `last_assistant_message`.
483	  # There is no completion clock — only the Stop event, pane death, or a generous
484	  # no-event backstop ends the wait — so a turn that works silently for minutes is
485	  # never failed.
486	  defp drive_turn_via_hooks(session, prompt, opts) do
487	    on_message = Keyword.get(opts, :on_message, fn _ -> :ok end)
488	    on_operator = Keyword.get(opts, :on_operator_message, fn -> :noop end)
489	    poll_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :poll_interval_ms, @turn_poll_ms)
490	    timeout_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :turn_timeout_ms) || Aiur.Config.agent_turn_timeout_ms()
491	    pause_confirm_ms = Keyword.get(opts, :pause_confirm_ms, @pause_confirm_ms)
492	    identifier = session.identifier
493	
494	    :ok = HookEvents.subscribe(identifier)
495	
496	    try do
497	      case submit_prompt(session, prompt, opts) do
498	        :ok ->
499	          # Backstop deadline is reset by every hook event, so it only fires for a
500	          # session that has gone fully silent (no tools, no Stop) — not a long turn.
501	          deadline = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) + timeout_ms
502	
503	          loop = %{
504	            session: session,
505	            identifier: identifier,
506	            on_message: on_message,
507	            on_operator: on_operator,
508	            poll_ms: poll_ms,
509	            pause_confirm_ms: pause_confirm_ms,
510	            timeout_ms: timeout_ms
511	          }
512	
513	          loop
514	          |> await_hook_turn(deadline, %{session_id: nil, message: nil})
515	          |> finish_hook_turn(on_message)
516	
517	        {:error, reason} ->
518	          emit(on_message, :turn_ended_with_error, %{reason: reason})
519	          {:error, reason}
520	      end
521	    after
522	      HookEvents.unsubscribe(identifier)
523	    end
524	  end

526	  # Receive loop driven by claude lifecycle hooks. Returns `:ok` (with the captured
527	  # response/session in `acc`), `{:paused, _}`, or `{:error, reason}`.
528	  defp await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc) do
529	    cond do
530	      not pane_alive?(loop.session) ->
531	        {:error, :repl_gone}
532	
533	      System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) >= deadline ->
534	        # No hook event at all within the (event-reset) backstop window: treat as a
535	        # stalled session. Not the normal completion path — that is the Stop event.
536	        Logger.warning("repl_hook_turn backstop_timeout identifier=#{loop.identifier}")
537	        {:error, :turn_timeout}
538	
539	      true ->
540	        receive do
541	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :stop} = event} ->
542	            {:ok, %{acc | session_id: event.session_id || acc.session_id, message: event.message}}
543	
544	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :post_tool_use} = event} ->
545	            # PostToolUse is a liveness heartbeat for turn detection only — the
546	            # conversation (incl. tool I/O) is painted by Aiur.Claude.DisplayTailer

548	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), merge_session(acc, event))

550	          {:claude_hook, _id, %{event: :user_prompt_submit} = event} ->
551	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), merge_session(acc, event))
552	
553	          {:claude_hook, _id, _event} ->
554	            await_hook_turn(loop, reset_deadline(loop), acc)

556	          # An operator message landed mid-turn. The REPL accepts input while the

559	            Logger.info("repl_hook_turn operator_immediate identifier=#{loop.identifier}")

563	          {:agent_queue_updated, _identifier, _item_id, _deliver_now} ->
564	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
565	
566	          {:agent_queue_updated, _identifier, _item_id} ->
567	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)

569	          # Pause request: interrupt the live REPL turn (Ctrl+C to the pane) and
570	          # park as paused. The interrupted turn still fires a Stop hook, which the
571	          # next turn's loop drains harmlessly.
572	          {:pause_agent, request_id} when is_integer(request_id) ->
573	            case interrupt(loop.session) do
574	              :ok -> :ok
575	              {:error, reason} -> Logger.warning("repl_pause interrupt_failed reason=#{inspect(reason)}")
576	            end

578	            {:paused, %{request_id: request_id}}
579	        after
580	          loop.poll_ms ->
581	            await_hook_turn(loop, deadline, acc)
582	        end
583	    end

    |> String.replace(~r/[[:cntrl:]'"`]/u, " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/\s+/u, " ")
